subject: Orchestra.ai trial: activation playlist, API routes & streaming handoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Liu <evan@orchestra.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchestra.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial intro — next steps and technical checklist

Thanks again for a great call today — appreciate the clarity on the business goals. Recap and proposed activation playlist below so we have a concrete POC plan to share with your engineering team. Can you confirm the owners for the four items marked across from your side?

Quick recap (what we heard)
- Primary objective: reduce user search latency and improve relevancy for in-app query assistance (target: median 150ms end-to-end for short prompts).
- Success criteria: 1) median latency <= 150ms for 90% of requests at 50 RPS test window; 2) relevancy lift measured by A/B: +8% click-through on suggestions; 3) no customer data leaves VPC (private deployment test).

Proposed activation playlist (week-by-week)
1) Week 0 (prep): exchange network allowlists, share service account keys for sandbox, confirm test dataset slices. (Owner: Orchestra)
2) Week 1: SDK integration + basic API route tests (POST /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings). Verify tokenization parity and request/response schemas. (Owner: Orchestra devs)
3) Week 2: Streaming test harness — validate websocket stream at wss://trial-stream.redwood.ai and fallback to chunked HTTP streaming. Confirm delta-stream semantics and reconnection behavior. (Owner: Orchestra infra)
4) Week 3: Tool-calling exercise — enable function/tool-calling with structured outputs (JSON schema) for the suggestion pipeline; run 1000 synthetic flows. (Owner: Redwood + Orchestra)
5) Week 4: Load run & acceptance — run 50 RPS window for 1 hour, collect latency/quality metrics, and review. (Joint)

Immediate asks for you
- Confirm owners for each week by EOD Monday.
- Provide sandbox service account and a small sample dataset (10k anonymized rows) by Thursday.

Attachments: I attached a one-page success metric sheet and a simple streaming diagram to illustrate our recommended routes.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short tech call to walk the steps.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: orchestra-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: streaming-route-diagram.png (image)
From: Evan Liu <evan@orchestra.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchestra.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial intro — next steps and technical checklist

Thanks Olga — this looks solid. Confirming our side owners below and a couple of technical clarifications.

Owners
- Week 0 / allowing & keys: Priya Shah (I will loop infra).
- Week 1 SDK work: Marcus (our platform SDK lead).
- Week 2 streaming: Suresh (realtime infra).
- Week 3 tool-calling: Priya + Marcus (joint).

Technical notes / clarifications
- For the SDK integration we'll use your Python client initially; Marcus prefers to validate via curl first against POST /v1/generate and POST /v1/embeddings to ensure payload parity.
- Streaming: we want to confirm the exact wire semantics for partial delta tokens and the presence of a final "done" event — if you have the stream protocol spec, please send it.
- Tool calling: we will provide JSON schema for the suggestion payload. One ask: can Redwood's runtime support function call batching so we can aggregate 3 small calls into 1 multi-call to reduce RTT?

We can provide the sample dataset by Wednesday (anonymized). We'll confirm owners in your tracker (linked).

Best,
Evan
Evan Liu
Head of Product, Orchestra.ai
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan@orchestra.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchestra.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial intro — next steps and technical checklist (internal action items)

Team — forwarding Evan's confirmations. Below are the internal action items I'm assigning so we hit the trial timeline:

Action items (internal)
- Ben: Prepare the streaming spec packet & confirm "done" event behavior. Include example websocket connect, server-sent events, and chunked-encoding fallback. Target: Tue EOD.
- Marissa: Stand up the sandbox trial environment mapping and create the mutual action plan in HubSpot (deal D-78432). Add timeline milestones and who signs off on acceptance. Target: Wed noon.
- Olga (me): Share our Python SDK quick-start repo, the stream protocol spec, and set up the kickoff tech call (Thu 10am PT).

Notes on function-call batching: We can support batched tool-calls via a multi-invoke endpoint (POST /v1/multi_call) that aggregates calls into a single execution unit; Ben, please verify latency numbers on batching vs single-call during your test run.

Evan / Priya — thank you for the rapid turnaround. We'll mark the owners in the tracker and confirm the tech kickoff invite shortly.

— Olga
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchestra.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial intro — next steps and technical checklist

Confirmed — we have owners assigned and will upload the anonymized sample dataset to the shared Drive folder by Wednesday 08/26. Marcus will be on the Thu 10am kickoff. Priya (infra) will join the streaming call.

One last ask: can you add an example of how Redwood handles KV cache TTL for conversational contexts (we need to understand memory limits during load)? If you can drop that in the stream spec packet that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Priya
Priya Shah
Platform Lead, Orchestra.ai
